known_issues.title: Beamos scorch marks last a few ticks longer
known_issues.detail: Hot_Floor 231 under a Beamos beam fades a few ticks later at 60: its own heat and fade are stepped as at 30 (the beam sets it each step, cLib_chaseF up 5 a tick while hit, down 0.4 after); the beam's half-step positions sweep a scorch once more than 30's whole-tick jumps do and add heat (finer sampling of the beam's path, like the water jar's edge): left as inherent (session bottom)

known_issues.title: A thrown water jar can break on an edge 30 misses
known_issues.detail: Dragon Roost room 8: thrown from about 100 units further back, the jar breaks on the floor's edge at 60 but in the lava at 30; 60's finer sampling catches an edge 30's step jumps over Decided (session bottom): inherent to the finer sampling (the jar moves on 30's ticks; its arc grazes the edge between two of them, where a 60 step lands), left.

known_issues.title: Ganon's Tower trial: the magma rocks' bob differs
known_issues.detail: The walk-in ends on 30's tick, and the rocks bob correctly on their own lava. The lava's bubbles come from the random stream, which parts from 30's before the warp: Outset's fishman picks his swim animation in a one-frame window that 30's ticks step over and 60's half steps land in, and his path is 0.7-1.6 units off from the start. After that every draw differs, so the bubbles do too. Not syncable: recorded (session bottom).

known_issues.title: Link: an action can change a tick off after his path drifts
known_issues.detail: Fixed: the turn in place and waiting start on 30's ticks; the turn while moving (a tick early), the swim's surfacing (a tick late) and a slash's next action (the spin's charge after a left slash, half a tick early) come on 30's ticks. Left: an action that starts at a threshold (a ledge reached, a turn's last 8000-unit step, a wall) can come a tick apart once his path is a few units or a degree off 30's, as in routes sidle and tour's corner

known_issues.title: Random-driven enemies drift from the 30 fps run
known_issues.detail: Random-driven enemies (Magtail waits, Peahat flights) drift from the 30 fps run, as expected

known_issues.title: Pots, sidling and ladders: one small leftover
known_issues.detail: Checked tick by tick at 30 and 60. Fixed: a thrown pot sank too fast in water (now within 0.2 units), and sidling ran up to 2.3 units ahead (now on 30's ticks). Lifting, carrying and throwing a pot, and a ladder up and down, already matched (the ladder within 0.2 units). Sidling round a corner was stuck at 60 and now turns on 30's tick. Left: a turn while carrying can end half a tick off after a tiny earlier drift

known_issues.title: Windfall at night
known_issues.detail: The lights converted (night via WWHD_DEBUG_TIME=905:345). The auction's bidders and the auction (361, 382) are 30's at every tick by night but for IDs given at their creation (session bottom); the bidding ran twice as fast at 60 (each bidder's interest, the pauses and waits counted per call) and is now once a tick: the six bids and the choice on 30's ticks, the bid's call a tick early left (session top). Not tested yet: the shutters (259) opening and closing

known_issues.title: Enemies falling into water
known_issues.detail: Fixed for open water: at 60 the half step after an enemy reached the water went on sinking, so a Moblin ran 13.5 units deeper than 30's; now the tick ends at the surface as at 30, and Moblins and Bokoblins sink on 30's heights. The hang at the Outset dock's edge is the dock itself (30's Moblin is pushed out of its side for a tick), not the water check

labels.242: spawned by code; its profile sits between Phantom Ganon's (241) and Puppet Ganon's (243)
labels.444: spawned by code; its profile sits between the Ballad's cyclone (TORNADO 443) and LOD (445)

queue_note: Round 13 (2026-10-08): the actors are converted, and the sessions fix the known bugs and drifts until 95% of the week (88% now). This round: the knockback's direction, the Stalfos, Armos, Bubble, Bokoblin, Floormaster and Magtail fights, enemies into water, Windfall's auction, Gohma's tail scene, pots. In the build on the owner's PC: everything up to e102375. After the wrap-up: performance for the Steam Deck and Android (B75), the rival's lessons, platforms (cloud sessions on the public GitHub repo), then uncapped.

queue.name: Now (top): B74, the title screen's fade at 60: the fade steps every frame instead of every tick (out in 0.45 s, 30's 0.9 s) and the black between waits 0.8 s (30's 0.4 s); finding the fader, then the boat's flicker. Then Windfall's shutters (259) opening and closing
Now (bottom): a turn while carrying a pot ended half a tick early (fixed, merging); next the lift's hand-over to carrying, a tick late (a play-once animation's end)

Now (qa): the decision hold for more approach kinds (merging, off unless listed); then a performance baseline for the Steam Deck (B75): CPU per thread at 60, the renderer's cost per draw, what the half steps cost

Enemy fights against 30 (fixed random, Link's farthest from 30's): fixed this round: Stalfos 760 -> 50, Armos 271 -> 28, Bubble 54 -> 4, the Bokoblin itself 151 -> 30, the Floormaster's hand 20 -> 1, the Magtail's rolls on 30's ticks, enemy knockback's direction (TICKVEC). Left, recorded: Floormaster 95 (a combo's parry), Kargaroc 89 (its swoops), Poe 70 (a held version mixed), Moblin (a fast knockback at a wall), the Stalfos's later blow (its club's pose in the spin)
Next: a deploy with B74 and the pots fix; everyone wraps up at 95% of the week with handoff notes; then the local history moves to the rewritten one (flossbud)

later: Performance for the Steam Deck and Android (B75: the game at 35-55% speed on a Deck, CPU-bound): the renderer's work per draw (texture change tracking, a buffer cache, async present), then the recompiled code (registers kept in host registers, a real-time build without the cycle counting, -O3), then more threads
The rival recomp's lessons (docs/research/rival-study.md): widescreen and resolution scaling, save states, what to adopt and do better
Platforms: Linux arm64, Windows, Android: cloud sessions on the public repo github.com/flossbud/WWHDRecomp (docs/cloud-handoff.md: CI, the ports, groundwork)
Uncapped frame rate (D21 step 4), built on the half steps: the owner's call when to start it
The owner's extensive testing and repair
